title: Children with Easter Baskets by Stone Wall, 1939 Fullerton B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
FADE PROOF
APR 21 1939
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
270 A
description: Two young children pose outdoors beside the trunk of a large tree and a low fieldstone retaining wall, both holding woven Easter baskets. The older boy on the left wears a zippered dark leather jacket, rolled cuffs on his trousers, and leather lace-up shoes, looking down into his basket filled with eggs. Beside him, a toddler in a dark button-up cardigan with white fuzzy trim and patterned floral trousers clutches an empty basket with both hands. Stamped on the back as processed by B. D. Wood in Fullerton, California, on April 21, 1939, just after Easter Sunday of that year.
